name: Allies
description: Aides and friends who help you in tasks — close, capable companions; each Ally is a Storyteller character.

name: Artifact
description: Wondrous devices of the First Age that you own, rated by power and rarity. (Dragon-Blooded receive twice the dots' worth of artifacts.)

name: Backing
description: Standing and rank within an organization of power, such as the Realm, a Guild, or a society. (An Abyssal in a Deathlord's service may not begin play with Backing — she takes Liege instead, p131.)

name: Contacts
description: Information sources and useful connections in various places.

name: Familiar
description: An animal companion bonded to you and sustained by your Essence, rated by capability.

name: Followers
description: Mortals who look to you for leadership, rated by their number and devotion.

name: Influence
description: Your pull and status in society — political, social, or commercial.

name: Manse
description: A geomantic structure over a demesne that produces Essence and houses a Hearthstone.

name: Mentor
description: A patron, teacher, or defender who advises and aids you, rated by their power. (An Abyssal in a Deathlord's service may not begin play with Mentor — she takes Liege instead, p131.)

name: Resources
description: Your material wealth and income, from destitute to fabulously wealthy.

name: Breeding
description: The purity of your Terrestrial bloodline: higher Breeding means more pronounced elemental markings, a stronger anima banner, and larger Essence pools.

name: Connections
description: Ties into one area of the Realm's web of institutions and cliques (chosen per instance, e.g. a House or the legions); serves as both Contacts and Influence for the Dragon-Blooded.

name: Command
description: The earned right to command soldiers of the legions or a House army, from a single fang (5) up to an entire dragon (500) fighting under your banner.

name: Henchmen
description: UnExalted characters of note who have sworn personal oaths of loyalty to you, rated by their number.

name: Reputation
description: How widely your exploits are known across the Dynasty and the Realm; may be added to Social rolls where fame carries weight (or subtracted where it is a liability).

name: Abyssal Command
description: You have been placed at the head of one of your Deathlord's military formations — battle-trained and moliated ghosts, ancestor-cult zealots or death-cult fanatics. Ranges from a small bodyguard (•) up to a double dragon of 500 war ghosts, 1,000 soldiers and 3,000 zombies (•••••). The Abyssal replacement for the Command Background.

name: Liege
description: The interest and favor your Deathlord takes in you, standing in for both Mentor and Backing (which loyal deathknights may not take). Grants extra bonus points at creation (2 at •, 4 at ••, 6 at •••, 9 at ••••, 12 at •••••) spendable on Abyssal Command, Artifact, Followers, Influence, Manse, Necromancy, Resources, Underworld Manse, Whispers, Caste/Favored Abilities or Charms. Renegade deathknights on the run from their masters may not buy Liege.

name: Necromancy
description: Training in the death-magic of the Underworld — you begin play knowing necromantic spells without swapping Charms for them: one Shadowlands-Circle spell at •, rising to seven Shadowlands/Labyrinth-Circle spells at •••••. Only Necromancy may be learned this way, never Terrestrial or Celestial sorcery.

name: Spies
description: A share of your Deathlord's espionage apparatus of demons, ghosts and informants — from five spies (•) up to a network spanning an entire Direction in both the living and dead worlds (•••••). You may use it to spy on foes and draw on its resources for protection, but have no discretionary access to its budget.

name: Underworld Manse
description: Access and attunement to the Deathlord's manses and Hearthstones within the Underworld (their power fails beyond the edge of the shadowlands). Manses in the land of the living must be bought with the ordinary Manse Background. A renegade who buys this receives only the benefits of the normal Manse Background (p145 of the core rulebook).

name: Whispers
description: Your attunement to the dead gods, letting you tap the lore lost in the Underworld's darkness. Once per night, roll Perception + Whispers to uncover a lost secret, be drawn toward where a death would matter most, or substitute Whispers for a single Ability (this last costs 1 temporary Willpower). At ••••• you are one with the Malfeans.
